Mem0 PostgreSQL.PGDATA: PostgreSQL data directory inside the Railway volume.
Mem0 PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_DB: Database used for vectors; the API creates a separate mem0_app database for users and settings.
Mem0 PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated password for the private pgvector database.

Mem0 API.ADMIN_API_KEY: Generated bootstrap API key for administrative and programmatic access.
Mem0 API.APP_DB_NAME: Database used for Mem0 users, API keys, settings, and request logs.
Mem0 API.AUTH_DISABLED: Keep false on Railway so API and dashboard authentication remain enabled.
Mem0 API.DASHBOARD_URL: Public dashboard origin allowed by the API CORS policy.
Mem0 API.HISTORY_DB_PATH: SQLite memory-history file stored on the Mem0 history volume.
Mem0 API.JWT_SECRET: Generated secret that signs dashboard access and refresh tokens.
Mem0 API.MEM0_DEFAULT_EMBEDDER_MODEL: Default OpenAI embedding model for new memories and searches.
Mem0 API.MEM0_DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL: Default OpenAI model for memory extraction.
Mem0 API.MEM0_TELEMETRY: Disables upstream anonymous onboarding telemetry by default.
Mem0 API.OPENAI_API_KEY: Required provider key for memory extraction and embeddings.
Mem0 API.OPENAI_BASE_URL: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL; leave blank for OpenAI.
Mem0 API.PORT: HTTP port used by Railway routing and health checks.
Mem0 API.POSTGRES_COLLECTION_NAME: pgvector collection used for memory embeddings.
Mem0 API.POSTGRES_DB: Reference to the vector database name.
Mem0 API.POSTGRES_HOST: Private Railway hostname of the pgvector service.
Mem0 API.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Password reference for the private pgvector service.
Mem0 API.POSTGRES_USER: Username reference for the private pgvector service.
Mem0 API.REQUEST_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS: Retention target used by Mem0's request-log pruning command.

Mem0 Dashboard.API_INTERNAL_URL: Private API URL used by dashboard server-side requests.
Mem0 Dashboard.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: Public API URL used by the browser.
Mem0 Dashboard.NEXT_PUBLIC_INSTANCE_NAME: Display name shown in the dashboard.
Mem0 Dashboard.PORT: Dashboard HTTP port used by Railway routing and health checks.
